text_block_list.text:
While walking with Daiwa Scarlet, we 
spotted Aston Machan taking photos of a 
blouse placed on a bench...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, looking good. The wind is 
blowing just right. This is our chance.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... what's going on? Spreading out a 
blouse like that... Is it a photo shoot?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. They're snapping photos 
non-stop to give her a glorious send-off.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The end, you say...? Ah, is there a stain 
on my sleeve...?
choice_data_list: That looks like a stubborn stain...
That looks like a stubborn stain...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I can no longer wear it. It is time to 
say goodbye."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh... But...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't that blouse your favorite? You used 
to wear it out all the time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We took plenty of photos, too. We can look 
back on them anytime.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but parting ways like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to wear it more too, 
Chan-chan?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Let's see if we can get that stain out! 
I'll help you! Okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I dabbed at it a bunch with a 
toothbrush, but... did the stain come 
out?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looks like set-in stains won't budge. 
Alright, on to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... 'Apply cleansing oil and 
rinse for the best results!' This is it!"

Daiwa Scarlet tried every trick in the 
book, but the stain on her blouse showed 
no sign of coming out...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is seriously stubborn dirt...! Maybe 
I should ask Hishi Ama-san for some 
advice—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet, it's alright now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this is the finish line. All 
that's left is to rest. My role is 
fulfilled, so it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Chan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
However... there must still be a way! You 
wouldn't give up just because you can't 
win a race, right? You put in enough 
effort to be reborn as someone new and—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! That's right! This blouse just needs 
to be reborn too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Chan, you had a doll, didn't you? 
Could you bring it over!

With Aston Machan's permission, Daiwa 
Scarlet cut the blouse down to doll-size. 
Then, she began stitching it together.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just wait a little longer. I swear I'll 
bring it back to life...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The blouse... is a new costume for 
the Chan-Mar doll...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fufu, do you like it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's strange... It feels as though the sun 
has set, and a different sun has risen in 
its place. Yet, that sun has the very same 
scent.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is this a "nice to meet you"? Or is it a 
"nice to see you again"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about "Looking forward to 
working together"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"We've been together this whole time, and 
we're gonna be together forever from now 
on too!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Machan thinks... that sounds good 
too.
choice_data_list: It feels like the doll is happy too.
It was like watching real magic!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, big smiles. Cuteness is 200% higher 
compared to our usual standard.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Fufu... Maybe if I post it 
on Umastagram, it might end up going 
totally viral♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho. So it's guaranteed to be a trend, 
then. Well, let us discuss future plans.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"As part of the Ma-chan Doll campaign, 
Ma-chan wants lots of this outfit made. 
Ma-chan senses an explosion in 
popularity."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Jeez, you never miss a trick, do you...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... For now, let's start thinking 
about the ingredients!

With the beautifully restored blouse as 
inspiration, Daiwa Scarlet and the others 
forged their vision. It was one filled 
with boundless hope!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, this much is only natural. I've 
always taken care of my own business, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Both of my parents were busy with work... 
so I've been doing sewing since I was 
little."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You can do it because of everything you've 
built up, can't you? Scarlet is such a 
good girl.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true. Thanks to that, I was 
able to be of help to Chan-me too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like the little girl I used to 
be has finally been rewarded.

Daiwa Scarlet gazed fondly at the Aston 
Machan doll. Then, with a bright smile, 
she began sharing stories from her 
childhood!
